“是你？”许麟脱口而出。
许紫烟想起那天的事情，神色有些尴尬，也施了一礼，轻声说道：
“见过许麟师兄。”
许麟上下打量了一下许紫烟，微笑着说道：“你也是家族中的子弟？”
“嗯。”许紫烟轻轻点头。
许麟轻轻点头，然后对着许丽等人说道：“你们先走吧，我和她有些话说。”
许丽几个人神色一愣，不过还是施了一礼之后，转身离开。此时看到许丽等人的态度，许紫烟已经明白，眼前的这个许麟恐怕是内堂的人，否则许丽他们也不会对他如此地尊敬。
如此一来，许紫烟的心里就有些担心，不知道自己的事情他知道多少？他把自己留下来，究竟要干什么？
许麟见到许丽他们已经离开，才客气地对许紫烟说道：“借一步说话。”
说完，便向着路边走去。许紫烟紧跟在他的身后来到了路边。大街上几乎没有了行人，天上飘洒着雪花，四处一片白茫茫的。许紫烟有些不安地看着许麟，轻声问道：
“许麟师兄找我有什么事情？”
“哦，也没有什么？”许麟淡淡地一笑道：“就是想问一问，那天之后，你有没有再见过我的师妹？”
许紫烟闻听一愣，心说，看来那个许喜妹已经不知道被族长给秘密弄到哪里去了，不会给杀了吧？
“就是那天和我在一起的那个女孩。”许麟看到许紫烟不说话，因为自己没有说清楚，便又解释了一遍。
“看来许麟并不知道后来发生了什么，即使是在店铺里发生的事情，他也不知道。”想到这里，许紫烟放下心，轻声说道：
“不知道，那天你们离开之后，我再也没有见过她。”
“哦~~”
许麟微微地皱了皱眉头，没有再言语。许紫烟想起那天的情景，脸上不禁微微发红，她对于那天的许麟，温文尔雅的举止很是有好感，便试探地问道：
“许麟师兄，那天那位小姐是你的恋人吗？”

“咳咳……”许麟被许紫烟的话惊得突然咳嗽了起来，尴尬地说道：“不是，她是我的师妹。突然间不见了，我有些担心，我问过很多人，他们都说不知道。”
看到许麟意外地咳嗽，许紫烟的脸就更加地红了，好在是在风雪交加的冬天，脸原本就被冻得红扑扑的，许麟也没有看出来。可是许紫烟自己的心里却是知道是怎么回事，于是便窘迫地对许麟说道：
“许麟师兄，如果没有别的事情，我就先走了。”
说完，也不等许麟说话，便低着头一路跑了开去。许麟望着许紫烟离去的背影，微笑着摇了摇头，转身消失在风雪之中。
回到自己的家中，许紫烟很快地就进入到修炼当中。她现在想要提升自己的实力的愿望非常地迫切，这个世界和她原来的那个世界不同，一切都是以实力为尊。想明白了这些，一颗心也就渐渐地平静了下来。引导着真气在体内循环了十八周天，缓缓地收功，只觉全身神清气爽。
忽闻外面传来敲门声，许紫烟起身来到门口，待拎着一个包裹，向着许紫烟微微施了一礼道：
“紫烟师姐。”
许紫烟神色一愣，迅即恢复如常，急忙微笑着请她入内。进入房间之后，许清雪将手中的包裹向着许紫烟一递道：
“这是送给紫烟师姐的。”
看着眼前的这个十三四岁的小丫头，许紫烟接过了包裹，道了一声谢，将其放到了桌子上。给许清雪倒了一杯茶，放到了她的面前，然后坐在她的对面，探究地望着她。
要说许紫烟真的不知道许清雪为什么来到自己的家中，自己前去拜访她的时候，她表现的很是冷淡，没有想到她能够带着礼物前来回拜自己。看着许清雪并没有比上次自己拜访她的时候热情多上一点儿，所以许紫烟就不知道许清雪前来的目的，也只好不言不语地坐在那里看着许清雪。
许清雪坐在那里，很静，很冷。眼睛平静得如同无波湖水，望着许紫烟冷声说道：
“紫烟师姐，我知道你的意思，只是我不善言谈，如果你想要和我交流，我们可以随时动手切磋。”
说到这里，停顿一下，眼神中的目光似乎波动了一下，轻声说道：
“我也想和紫烟姐姐经常切磋，紫烟姐姐是后天第六层吧，我也是。”

"Is it you?" Xu Lin blurted out.
Xu Ziyan looked a little embarrassed when she thought of what happened that day, and gave a salute and said softly:
"I've met senior brother Xu Lin."
Xu Lin looked Xu Ziyan up and down, smiled and said: "Are you also a child of the family?"
"Yeah." Xu Ziyan nodded slightly.
Xu Lin nodded lightly, and then said to Xu Li and others: "You go first, I have something to say with her."
Xu Li and others looked stunned, but they still bowed and turned to leave. Seeing the attitude of Xu Li and others at this time, Xu Ziyan already understood that the Xu Lin in front of him was probably from the inner hall, otherwise Xu Li and the others would not respect him so much.
As a result, Xu Ziyan felt a little worried. How much did he know about his own affairs? What on earth did he want to do by leaving himself behind?
When Xu Lin saw that Xu Li and the others had left, he politely said to Xu Ziyan: "Take a step to speak."
After saying that, he walked towards the roadside. Xu Ziyan followed him to the roadside. There were almost no pedestrians on the street, snowflakes were falling in the sky, and everything was white. Xu Ziyan looked at Xu Lin uneasily and asked softly:
"What does Senior Brother Xu Lin want from me?"
"Oh, it's nothing?" Xu Lin said with a faint smile: "I just want to ask, have you seen my junior sister again after that day?"
Xu Ziyan was stunned when she heard this, and said to herself, it seems that Xu Ximei no longer knows where the clan leader has secretly taken her, and she won't be killed, right?
"It's the girl who was with me that day." Xu Lin saw that Xu Ziyan didn't speak because he didn't explain clearly, so he explained again.
"It seems that Xu Lin didn't know what happened later. Even what happened in the store, he didn't know." Thinking of this, Xu Ziyan felt relieved and said softly:
"I don't know. After you left that day, I never saw her again."
"Oh~~"
Xu Lin frowned slightly and said nothing. Xu Ziyan couldn't help but blush slightly when she thought of the scene that day. She was very fond of Xu Lin's gentle behavior that day, so she asked tentatively:
"Senior Brother Xu Lin, was that young lady your lover that day?"
"Ahem..." Xu Lin was startled by Xu Ziyan's words and coughed suddenly, and said awkwardly: "No, she is my junior sister. She disappeared suddenly, and I was a little worried. I asked many people, and they all said they didn't know."
Seeing Xu Lin coughing unexpectedly, Xu Ziyan's face turned even redder. Fortunately, it was a snowy winter, and his face was already red from the cold, and Xu Lin didn't notice it. But Xu Ziyan knew what was going on in his heart, so he said to Xu Lin in embarrassment:
"Senior Brother Xu Lin, if there is nothing else, I will leave first."
After saying that, without waiting for Xu Lin to speak, he lowered his head and ran away. Xu Lin looked at Xu Ziyan's leaving back, shook his head with a smile, turned around and disappeared into the wind and snow.
Returning to his home, Xu Ziyan quickly entered into practice. Her desire to improve her strength now is very urgent. This world is different from her original world. Everything is based on strength. After thinking about this, my heart gradually calmed down. Guiding the true energy to circulate in the body for eighteen weeks, he slowly completed the exercise and felt that his whole body was refreshed and refreshed.
Suddenly hearing a knock on the door from outside, Xu Ziyan stood up and came to the door. Holding a package, she gave a slight salute to Xu Ziyan:
"Senior Sister Ziyan."
Xu Ziyan looked stunned for a moment, then quickly returned to normal, and hurriedly smiled and invited her in. After entering the room, Xu Qingxue handed the package in his hand to Xu Ziyan:
"This is for Senior Sister Ziyan."
watchingThe little girl of thirteen or fourteen years old in front of her, Xu Ziyan took the package, thanked her, and put it on the table. He poured Xu Qingxue a cup of tea and placed it in front of her, then sat opposite her and looked at her inquiringly.
To say that Xu Ziyan really didn't know why Xu Qingxue came to her home, when she went to visit her, she was very cold and did not expect that she could come to pay her respects with a gift. Seeing that Xu Qingxue was not a little more enthusiastic than the last time he visited her, Xu Ziyan didn't know the purpose of Xu Qingxue's visit, so she had to sit there and look at Xu Qingxue in silence.
Xu Qingxue sat there, very quiet and cold. His eyes were as calm as the waveless lake water, looking at Xu Ziyan and saying coldly:
"Senior Sister Ziyan, I know what you mean, but I'm not good at talking. If you want to communicate with me, we can discuss it at any time."
At this point, he paused, his eyes seemed to waver, and he said softly:
"I also want to compete with Sister Ziyan often. Sister Ziyan is on the sixth level the day after tomorrow, and so am I."
